specs.keyboard_notes: Full numpad, shallow mushy keys, non-haptic trackpad

Dell 16 Plus 2-in-1 16" WUXGA IPS Touchscreen Laptop - Intel Ultra 7 256V - 16GB LPDDR5 - 1TB SSD - Intel Arc - Windows 11 Pro - Ice Blue

reviews.quote: This big-screen convertible laptop certainly has some positives but there are a few too many minuses to give this Plus a full-throated recommendation.

praises: Strong single-core snappiness for office multitasking (GB6 single 2760, best in CNET's 16" 2-in-1 field)
Sturdy chassis with a clean, understated Ice Blue design
Full-size numpad — a real productivity plus on a 16" convertible
Big bright touch panel that 'really shines in tablet mode' (CNET)
Sale price ~$1,530 makes a 16" 2-in-1 with Arc 140V very affordable
complaints: Battery is class-worst: CNET logged 8:58, well behind Yoga 7 16 (10:57) and Envy x360 16 (11:11)
Mushy shallow keyboard; CNET's spacebar 'frequently failed to register my inputs'
Down-firing speakers sound 'hollow and muffled, as though audio was being broadcast from inside a cardboard box'
At 2.0 kg it is heavier than the Spectre x360 16 and Yoga 7 16
Only one Thunderbolt 4 port, no SD reader, no Kensington slot; soldered RAM

design_philosophy: Dell's 2025 rebrand put the 16 Plus 2-in-1 in the consumer mid tier: Lunar Lake silicon chosen for efficiency over raw multi-core punch, a big touch panel, and cost cuts (single TB4, down-firing speakers, shallow keyboard) to hit an aggressive price. This CA config pairs the efficiency chip with the basic 16" 1200p IPS panel rather than CNET's mini-LED, trading screen quality for the lowest big-screen convertible price on the shelf.
rating_notes: Ratings inferred from CNET's DB06250 review (Ultra 7 258V/32GB/2.5K mini-LED, 7.3/10). This CA config: 256V vs 258V (-0.3 gaming), 16GB vs 32GB (-0.5 productivity), and the 16" 1920x1200 IPS instead of mini-LED drops screen_quality 8.0->5.0 — CNET warned that panel 'sounds like a recipe for fuzzy, grainy text'. Battery +0.5 vs anchor for IPS backlight efficiency. RTINGS/NBC/PCMag had no review of this line (bot-walls confirmed; see SHARED-dell-2in1.md).
